item.text: {"verdict_id":"L3-7a3f9c21","level":"L3","outcome":"pass","defect_class_hypothesis":null,"trigger_steps":["应用已处于主 Feed 页面","点击底部导航栏的 Search 标签（nav_tab_search）","确认 Search 标签处于 selected 状态且 search_card 可见","停留在 Search 标签页，未点击 search_card 或进入 SearchActivity"],"evidence":[{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"after-segment-0 UI layout: nav_tab_search","note":"nav_tab_search 明确处于 selected 状态，满足已进入底部 Search 标签页的前提。"},{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"after-segment-0 UI layout: search_card","note":"resource-id 为 search_card 的节点存在且可点击、可聚焦，表明搜索入口卡片可见。"},{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"after-segment-0 UI layout: search_text_view and search_icon","note":"search_text_view 文本和 search_icon 内容描述均为“Search Wikipedia”，清楚邀请用户搜索 Wikipedia，未错误描述阅读历史、最近浏览、已保存页面、编辑活动或其他非搜索功能。"},{"type":"llm_reasoning","ref":"scenario journey result action-1","note":"动作执行状态为 PASSED，且执行说明确认未进入 SearchActivity，checkpoint 与规格要求的验证位置一致。"}],"confidence":0.99}
